## Seven Kingdoms

Historically, before Aegon I Targaryen united Westeros, there were seven
independent kingdoms:

| No  | Kingdom                              | Ruling House (at Conquest) | Capital / Seat |
| --- | ------------------------------------ | -------------------------- | -------------- |
| 1   | Kingdom of the North                 | Stark                      | Winterfell     |
| 2   | Kingdom of the Mountain and the Vale | Arryn                      | The Eyrie      |
| 3   | Kingdom of the Isles and the Rivers  | Hoare                      | Harrenhal      |
| 4   | Kingdom of the Rock                  | Lannister                  | Casterly Rock  |
| 5   | Kingdom of the Reach                 | Gardener                   | Highgarden     |
| 6   | Storm Kingdom                        | Durrandon                  | Storm's End    |
| 7   | Principality of Dorne\*              | Martell                    | Sunspear       |

- Dorne joined later through marriage rather than conquest.

## Houses

After Aegon's Conquest, the realm became known as the Seven Kingdoms, but the
political divisions evolved into these regions:

| No  | House     | Region       | Capital / Seat | Sigil                      | Motto                     |
| --- | --------- | ------------ | -------------- | -------------------------- | ------------------------- |
| 1   | Targaryen | Crownlands   | Dragonstone    | Three-Headed Red Dragon    | Fire and Blood            |
| 2   | Stark     | The North    | Winterfell     | Grey Direwolf              | Winter is Coming          |
| 3   | Baratheon | Stormlands   | Storm's End    | Black Stag on Gold         | Ours is the Fury          |
| 4   | Lannister | Westerlands  | Casterly Rock  | Golden Lion                | Hear Me Roar!             |
| 5   | Tyrell    | The Reach    | Highgarden     | Golden Rose                | Growing Strong            |
| 6   | Tully     | Riverlands   | Riverrun       | Silver Trout               | Family, Duty, Honor       |
| 7   | Arryn     | The Vale     | The Eyrie      | Falcon and Crescent Moon   | As High as Honor          |
| 8   | Martell   | Dorne        | Sunspear       | Red Sun Pierced by a Spear | Unbowed, Unbent, Unbroken |
| 9   | Greyjoy   | Iron Islands | Pyke           | Golden Kraken              | We Do Not Sow             |
